rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone actively tries to secure an object, result, or opportunity.

example.english: We will continue to solicit the opportunity to host this event.
example.traditional: 我哋會繼續爭取主辦呢個活動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 gai3 zuk6 zang1 ceoi2 zyu2 baan6 ni1 go3 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone approaches or entices people to buy sexual services.

example.english: Those women solicit men for sex outside the bar.
example.traditional: 嗰啲女人喺酒吧門口拉客。
example.jyutping: go2 di1 neoi5 jan2 hai2 zau2 baa1 mun4 hau2 laai1 haak3

rows.note: Use this for formally petitioning an authority or organization.

example.english: The residents solicit the government to preserve that old tree by signing a petition.
example.traditional: 居民聯署請願，要求政府保留嗰棵老樹。
example.jyutping: geoi1 man4 lyun4 syu5 cing2 jyun6 jiu1 kau4 zing3 fu2 bou2 lau4 go2 fo2 lou5 syu6
